<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Run the test suites declared in anchors.yaml and ingest the reports.

```text
Runs what the PROJECT declared in `tests:` and ingests what the run left behind.

  anchors test                    every declared layer: only its files STALE and below the minimum,
                                  and the never measured (each suite's run_changed: receives them)
  anchors test --all              every file, through run: — the whole run
  anchors test --include-fresh    also the fresh files below the minimum
  anchors test --include-passing  also the stale files at the minimum or above
  anchors test --budget 60s       fastest first, until the time is spent
  anchors test unit               unit only
  anchors test unit integration   more than one, in the file's order
  anchors test -w backend         filters by workspace (monorepo)
  anchors test --changed a.ts     INCREMENTAL: only the impact path of what changed
  anchors test --then check       on passing, charges the gates with the signal still fresh

Two modes, the same as check's: FULL (without --changed) runs the "run:"; INCREMENTAL
runs the "run_changed:", which receives in {{files}} the files of the impact path -
the SAME cut that "check --changed" uses, so the two do not disagree about what
your commit moves.

Anchors does not know how to run a test — the stack is the project's. It executes the declared `run:`
and binds the `junit:`/`lcov:` to the map, which is the step that usually gets forgotten.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors test [layers...] [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` |  | run every file of the suites through `run:`, whatever their state — the whole run, as before the state selection |
| `--budget` | `0s` | run the files FASTEST FIRST, in batches through `run_changed:`, until this much time is spent (e.g. 60s, 10m); the rest is left for a later run. The order comes from the times recorded by earlier runs; files never timed go last |
| `--changed` |  | INCREMENTAL mode: changed file(s) — runs the `run_changed:` over the union of the impact paths, the same slice as `check --changed` |
| `--include-fresh` |  | also run files measured at the current version that are below the minimum (by default only STALE files below the minimum run) |
| `--include-passing` |  | also run stale files at the minimum or above (by default only files BELOW the minimum run); with --include-fresh, fresh passing files too |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--scope` |  | filters by the declared SCOPE (`isolated`, `full`) — only on mutation. Without this, runs whichever are declared |
| `--skip-unmeasured` |  | leave out the files never measured (by default they run) |
| `--target` |  | target that replaces `{{target}}` in the declared `run:` (e.g. the file to mutate) |
| `--then` |  | on PASSING, chains Anchors commands: `check`, `coverage` (separate by comma). Opt-in — without this, it runs and stops |
| `-w`, `--workspace` |  | filters by the declared WORKSPACE (backend, mobile…) — repeatable or comma-separated. Combines with the layers: `anchors test unit -w backend` |

## O mapa e seus sinais — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors map`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/map/) | Operate the dependency map (anchors.graph.yaml) |
| [`anchors ingest`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/ingest/) | Ingest test signals (JUnit/lcov) the project generated and bind them to the map |
| **`anchors test`** | Run the test suites declared in anchors.yaml and ingest the reports |
| [`anchors mutation`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/mutation/) | Run the mutation suites declared in anchors.yaml and ingest the reports |
| [`anchors keep-evidence`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/keep-evidence/) | Declare that a change proves nothing new, keeping the files' evidence fresh |
| [`anchors stamp`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/stamp/) | Write the missing `@contract` stamps on test doubles (never rewrites an existing one) |
| [`anchors recode`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/recode/) | Rename an identity code and propagate it across the project |
| [`anchors renumber`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/renumber/) | Renumber the revisions this branch added when the base already took their number |
| [`anchors generated-paths`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/generated-paths/) | The paths of DERIVED files — whoever conflicts in them rebuilds |
| [`anchors merge-progress`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/merge-progress/) | Progress merge driver: unites both sides, `[x]` beats `[ ]` |
